rules.description: Layout must render a 'main' slot as primary content area
Use <header>, <nav>, <main>, <aside>, <footer> — not generic divs for layout regions
Every slot prop must be typed as React.ReactNode
Layout must define responsive behavior for mobile, tablet, and desktop breakpoints
Include a visually-hidden skip-to-main-content link for keyboard users
Use max-w-* or container — never fixed pixel widths on layout shells
Use Tailwind utility classes — not inline style={{}} objects
